set.body:
Parked on 19 November 2026 (docs/plan.md).

Grants name one person. SHARE1 shares with named people, which is exact and easy to explain. Sharing with a lab, so that people who join later are included and people who leave lose access, needs a grant whose recipient is a lab membership. Decide after the SHARE5 rehearsal whether stewards ask for it.
set.title: LATER: Share with a whole lab in one step
